justification: Image A depicts a carved stone stela covered in dense glyphic/symbolic blocks arranged in a grid pattern, viewed with a seated human figure for scale, while Image B depicts a staircase flanked by relief carvings of leaves/feathers and a standing figure in profile. There is no shared iconographic content: no common motif (no glyph blocks, no staircase, no figural relief) appears in both, and the compositional logic (grid of abstract symbolic units vs. architectural staircase with figural reliefs) is entirely different.
